courses.title: Complete Digital Marketing Masterclass
courses.shortDescription: Live online training in complete digital marketing masterclass for women who want practical, home-friendly skills.
courses.description: LIVE ONLINE TRAINING – NOT A RECORDED COURSE. This one-month Zoom programme focuses on social media, advertising and online promotion for businesses and personal brands. You will attend four live classes each week, complete practical exercises and take part in question-and-answer sessions with the instructor. Useful for managing social pages for local businesses, freelancing marketing services, or supporting family businesses online. Intakes are planned for the 1st of every month. Exact class days and timings are shared with registered participants after enrolment. Classes are interactive; this is not a pre-recorded video course.
courses.schedule: Four live classes per week. Exact class days and timings will be shared with registered participants.
learningOutcomes: Plan a basic content calendar for social platforms
Create simple promotional posts and captions
Understand how paid and organic reach differ
Track basic engagement metrics
requirements: Smartphone or computer with a stable internet connection
Willingness to attend scheduled live Zoom sessions
Notebook or digital document for exercises and notes
Access to Facebook, Instagram or WhatsApp for practice
